source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.34: Figments, the Visualizer and the Rigger (Classes 3.0 step 8; docs/design/figments-spec.md). Every number PROVISIONAL (spec section 14, items 2100 to 2199).

visualizer.text: The Visualizer holds one mana core of its own (charge). Making a Figment and acting through one need it in a hand; held Figments stay while it is carried. Projection range: range.base + your Visualization tiles (range.no_door for a Rigger without the door).

level.note: A Figment's level-1 numbers grow by the enemy table at its owner's level (enemies.json levels): HP by hp_mult x damage_mult (it soaks the same share of a Soldier-turn at every level), Defense by defense_plus, armour by armour_mult. Its damage grows only by output.level.deal (the figment profile), never by skill.

limits.note: At most 4 Figments held (the Rigger at Visualization 7), plus the Rigger's Double and one Scrap Turret: 6 owned units a character.

upkeep.text: At your turn start: n charge for each Figment held; holding ap_from or more also costs ap AP that turn. Short of charge, the newest unravels for each charge missing.

let_go.text: Let go (verbs.let_go): unmake one; refund_share of its made charge (rounded down) goes back into the core. A Figment destroyed by damage gives nothing back and Snaps: your next turn has snap_ap AP less (at most once a turn).

ladder.text: The door: Picture, the Double, 1 held, range 5. The Visualizer also works out of a fight.
Eye and Wall; 2 ready designs, one trait each.
2 held; Beast and Blade; 3 ready designs.
A destroyed Figment no longer Snaps.

lure.text: A Double lures by the fire doctrine of enemies.json (double_save): a tier with none is always fooled; the others save (Brain, against 12 + your Visualization strength, plus the tier's double_save) on first sight, an Elite and a Boss again at each of their turn starts, a Boss never two rounds running. An enemy that found a Double out gets found_out_add against your later Doubles this fight.

unit_effects.text: What every Figment is: no saves, immune to every condition (the Body, Brain and Heart families), to Bleeding and to Hidden (it never hides: Shadow is a character's). Each form's verb item (fig_<form>, collect.ts) holds these and its own.

forms.name: Double
forms.text: A second you the bots build: {=hp} HP, your Defense, your pace. It draws fire: Minions and Vermin always take it for you; Soldiers, Elites and Bosses make a Brain save.

forms.name: Eye
forms.text: A floating eye: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tiles an AP, flying. It sees {=vision} tiles, in the dark too, for your whole side. Stare: one unit it sees stays seen by your side until your next turn, Hidden or not.

forms.name: Wall
forms.text: Movable cover: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, {=movement} tile an AP. Full cover; it blocks movement and sight for both sides and nothing pushes it.

forms.name: Beast
forms.text: A fast striker: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, {=movement} tiles an AP. Strike is a melee attack with its claws; Pounce runs a short straight line and strikes, and a hit knocks the target Prone unless it passes a Body save.

forms.name: Blade
forms.text: A floating blade: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tiles an AP. Cut strikes an enemy next to it. Hold: the first enemy each round to enter or leave a tile next to it is Cut, and that spends one of your reactions.

turret.name: Scrap Turret
turret.text: A turret built from scrap: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, it does not move. At each of your turn starts for {=rounds} rounds it makes its weapon's plain attack at the nearest enemy it can reach.

verbs.name: Strike
verbs.text: A melee attack with the Figment's own weapon.

verbs.name: Pounce
verbs.text: Up to {=dash} tiles in a straight line, then a Strike; a hit knocks the target Prone (Body save).

verbs.name: Cut
verbs.text: A melee attack on an enemy next to it.

verbs.name: Stare
verbs.text: One unit it sees stays seen by your side until your next turn, Hidden or not.

verbs.name: Let go
verbs.text: Unmake it: half its made charge (rounded down) goes back into the core.

traits.name: Swift
traits.text: +{=tiles} tiles an AP; its moves draw no opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Loud
traits.text: Enemies count it as the most hurt in reach, Minions included.

traits.name: Volatile
traits.text: Destroyed (not let go): a burst of radius {=within}, {=amounts.burst.base} on everyone in it, both sides.

traits.name: Tethered
traits.text: Its projection range +{=range}; it unravels only past twice that.

traits.name: Mirror
traits.text: It lures as a Double would, in the look of any unit of your side you pick.

traits.name: Barbed
traits.text: An enemy that hits it in melee takes {=amounts.barb.base}.

traits.name: Keen
traits.text: Its attacks +{=roll} to hit; an Eye sees {=vision} further.

traits.name: Hollow
traits.text: Costs {=charge|abs} charge less (never under one); HP x{=hp_mult}.

items.name: Picture
items.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP and the form's charge (more for each trait) from your Visualizer. A Figment of a ready design or a bare form you have opened appears on a free tile your side sees within your projection range. Needs the Visualizer in hand.

items.name: Load the Visualizer
items.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP and a spare core: the Visualizer's core is swapped for a fresh one, full.
